impressions.text: The delivery addressed watcher noise from locked-worker polls, merge follow-up races, and repeated errors.
The worker implemented silent lock skips, deferred incomplete same-account merge notices, and error deduplication with hourly reminders and recovery reporting.
Review caught three missing test behaviors; the worker added regression tests, including one that exposed duplicate reports across steps and led to deduplication by identical error message.
The worker reported passing checks and green CI, and the orchestrator reported the PR merged.
